mapping_json.fidelity_notes: The crosswalk section-5 NAMES this kit for PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime ('DoT/uptime ramps (RF...)') — door assignment is law-direct. DEFENSIVE_TRADEOFF carries the life/defense-trade half: the build IS the regen-vs-self-burn race. Toggle -> persistent_condition_shape=tick-cost (section-3 stance/toggle lane), the tick paid from life. SOURCE MAGNITUDE CLAMPED: the source burn is near-lethal (~90% of life+ES per second, out-regenned by stacked regen); engine hp_cost_scale is LOCKED at 0.30 max — mapped at the cap (aurabot b01 clamp precedent), so the race survives at lower stakes. Ailment burn native (fire family). Variants (Chieftain / Inquisitor / historical low-life Occultist+Guardian) collapse to the same chassis with different sustain sources. Longest-lived kit in the batch (1.x through 3.20+, 'most durable SSF progression curve of any skill gem').
